feature: PATCH_009: same-building check and persistent comparison alert. (1) Premise book: building size (gross floor area, footprint, storeys, dwelling units) is compared across the Projects; a floor-area difference over 3 % or any storey/unit difference is a red C-list row that must be decided before the copies can be created. (2) A red alert above every tab stays while loaded comparison copies are not recalculated (Module 5, then 6/7) or are of different-sized buildings; the load-time popup alone could be dismissed. Ordinary comparisons of different buildings get no alert. New dev_checks/patch_009_same_building_and_recalc_alert_self_check.py. Includes PATCH_008 and earlier.
